name: Understanding Your Beliefs
overview: Scripture calls believers to seek wisdom and understanding as essential pursuits, urging us to trust in the Lord rather than relying on our own insight. Loving God with all our heart, soul, and mind is foundational, and through diligent seeking of knowledge and discernment, we grow in prudence and truth. This truth, revealed by Christ, brings freedom and equips us to navigate life with a discerning and steadfast faith.
